peoples.name: Human
peoples.description: Human households follow many local ways of life. Their traditions are learned from neighbours and family, rather than belonging to a single culture.

peoples.name: Dwarf
peoples.description: Dwarves are a broad-built people whose communities often value the memory of skilled work. Their households belong to many cultures; no craft or calling is inherited as a rule.

peoples.name: Woodland Elf
peoples.description: Woodland elves keep varied household traditions shaped by their surroundings. Some live among trees, while others make their homes in ports, fields and towns.

peoples.name: Hearth Elf
peoples.description: Hearth elves are an elven people found in settled communities and travelling households. Shared stories and careful hospitality are common themes, with ample room for individual lives.

peoples.name: Smallfolk
peoples.description: Smallfolk are a short-statured people with communities in many landscapes. Household ties often matter to them, but neither ancestry nor birthplace determines a calling.

peoples.name: Orc
peoples.description: Orcs are a sturdy people whose households preserve many different customs. Their lives include ordinary work, learning and friendship, rather than one inherited temperament.

peoples.name: Goblin
peoples.description: Goblins are a small people with varied local communities. Careful repair and practical invention feature in some households; individuals choose their own work and values.

peoples.name: Emberkin
peoples.description: Emberkin are a scaled humanoid people with many regional traditions. Their ancestry describes appearance and community ties, not exceptional powers or a promised magical calling.

roles.name: Vanguard
roles.description: An intended front-line presence. This is a provisional party role, not a class or a set of combat abilities.

roles.name: Scout
roles.description: An intended observer and pathfinder. This role grants no movement, skill or perception bonuses.

roles.name: Adept
roles.description: An intended student of unusual knowledge. No spells, magical powers or class levels are assigned.

roles.name: Expert
roles.description: An intended practical problem-solver. This role grants no skills, tools or mechanical advantages.
